extension.summary: Classic TV broadcast simulation — 24/7 themed channels synced to wall-clock time
extension.description: Classic TV recreates the experience of watching cable television circa 1990–2010 on a real CRT. Themed channels play continuously, synchronized to wall-clock time so every viewer sees the same content at the same moment. The addon asks the Schedule_Service on jfmac what is playing and plays it — all schedule logic lives server-side.
